text.content: EJ] Grammar 2 Adverbs of intensity; quantifiers with verbs
Adverbs of intensity Quantifiers with verbs
Add the adverbs and quantifiers to the sentences. Then compare with a partner.
It snows a lot in Moscow in the winter.
It rains in Seattle in the winter. (quite a bit)
It’s cold in Busan in January. (extremely)
It’s cool in Rabat in the rainy season. (fairly)
It snows in Lima in July. (not... at all)
It's windy in Wellington all year. (pretty)
A Listen to people talk about the weather in three cities. Which city is one of the
people planning to visit? Circle the city.
2 Antigua, Guatemala The __________ season is from November to April.
B ©) Listen again. Complete the sentences with the correct words.
A Write two true sentences and two false sentences about the weather where you
pretty sunny rain alot somewhat cloudy
extremely hot very windy fairly cool
B Read your sentences. Your partner
corrects the false sentences. Take turns.
A: It's pretty Sunny in the winter.
B: | think that’s false. It’s somewhat cloudy in the winter.
